limitations: CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode reports actual fonts used by child text nodes, not each individual character.
Only real UI nodes are queried. No cloned probes, FontFace.check coverage test or DOM text replacement is used.
Exported PNG has no DOM/platform-font trace. Its text corpus must additionally be covered by the decoded WOFF2 cmap and its image/canvas checks; this proof does not infer a font from PNG pixels.
Glyph geometry/collision validation remains a separate 270-case test. This font proof does not replace it.
